verdict.rationale: Rootly's own schedule docs cover rotations, layers, overrides, restrictions and previews. Schedules can nest across teams or geographies, and holiday, PTO and shadowing support is claimed. Round robin is documented only in escalation policies, not in schedule rotations, and time zones are never explicitly mentioned. missing for 10: explicit time-zone handling for schedules, round-robin within schedule rotations (only shown in escalation policies), detailed rotation configuration docs, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an SRE, I can build on-call schedules with rotations, layers, time zones, and round-robin coverage that match how my teams actually work

citations.quote: Create, manage, and maintain on-call schedules in Rootly with rotations, layers, overrides, restrictions, and previews to keep coverage clear and predictable.
A schedule can be as simple as a single user rotating weekly, or as complex as multiple schedules nested within one another, representing different teams or geographies.
Rotations built in minutes, with holidays, PTO, and shadowing
Configure Rootly escalation policies with multi-step targets, time delays, and round robin to make sure on-call alerts get acknowledged and acted on.
